row.evidence: Cloudsmith's SCIM docs say "SCIM authentication is available and enabled by default for users on Ultra and Enterprise plans" and "Your account must be on an Ultra or Enterprise plan", while its audit-log docs list Pro as a lower plan.
row.notes: New row. cloudsmith.com/pricing sits behind a Vercel Security Checkpoint (HTTP 429 to curl and WebFetch; renderer ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES), so no prices were captured and pricing_page_url points at the SCIM doc that states the plan gate. Plan names Pro < Ultra < Enterprise come from the audit-log docs; Pro is taken as the team plan, so SCIM on Ultra is a higher-tier gate (gated). SCIM 2.0 at https://api.cloudsmith.io/scim/v2 with Basic auth (username 'token' + generated SCIM token); needs the Owner role and a claimed domain; works with any generic SCIM 2.0 IdP (Cloudsmith links Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, OneLogin, Ping guides). IdP groups map to same-named teams (auto-created) and SCIM removes team members absent from the IdP group; SCIM cannot assign workspace roles (users get Member). SAML SSO is enabled via Support; its plan gate is not stated in the reachable docs. The REST API (X-Api-Key) covers members, invites, teams and audit logs.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit log review: custom, up to 1 year.

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > Authentication > SCIM (copy SCIM authentication token; username 'token')

operations.notes: Docs say SCIM provisions, de-provisions and updates profile information; PUT vs PATCH and hard delete are not specified.

deprovision.notes: 'De-provision existing users' is stated but whether that deactivates or removes the member is not.

attributes.notes: Docs list mandatory fields email, givenName, familyName and email as the unique identifier; SCIM paths shown are the standard equivalents. Group name maps to team name.

roles.how: SCIM groups cannot set Owner/Manager/Collaborator roles; provisioned users get Member and roles are changed manually.

limitations.text: Configuring SCIM removes team members who are not in the mapped IdP group.
No role mapping from IdP groups.
Requires the Owner role and at least one claimed domain.

capabilities.notes: Members are added by invite; update is limited to role and visibility; DELETE removes the member from the organization.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a member from the organization
Create a SAML Group Sync mapping
List audit log entries for a namespace

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks in the API are repository-scoped; no user/member events documented.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log events include member invited, member removed and user deactivated.

okta.notes: No OIN listing (okta.com/integrations/cloudsmith/ 404); Cloudsmith points to Okta's generic SCIM app guide and has its own Okta SAML guide.

entra.notes: No gallery tutorial (cloudsmith-tutorial 404); generic Entra SCIM.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML Group Sync maps IdP SAML groups to teams (API endpoints documented).
